create_racecar_instance: create a Racecar instance with a pybullet client and URDF root path for simulation
reset_racecar: reset the Racecar to load the URDF model and configure gear constraints between wheels
get_observation: get the Racecar observation vector containing base position and orientation from the physics client
apply_action: apply motor velocity and steering angle commands to the Racecar wheels via joint motor control
get_action_dimension: get the Racecar action dimension which returns the number of motorized wheels
